title_zh: BBRF 免費網上講座：預測自殺意念結果——人格、認知與腦功能
title_en: BBRF Free Webinar: Predicting Suicidal Ideation Outcomes
summary_zh: 2026 年 11 月 10 日美東時間下午 2 時，腦與行為研究基金會舉辦免費網上講座。McLean 醫院 Jenna Traynor 博士分享以人格障礙評估、認知測量與神經影像預測高危精神科群體自殺意念結果的新發現，並討論針對認知控制與情緒調節腦網絡的新興治療。主持人為基金會主席 Jeffrey Borenstein 醫生。
summary_en: The Brain & Behavior Research Foundation's free webinar on November 10, 2026 (2:00 p.m. ET; 3:00 a.m. Macau time, November 11) features McLean Hospital's Jenna Traynor, PhD, on predicting suicidal ideation outcomes from personality, cognition and brain function in high-risk psychiatric populations, including borderline personality disorder. Registration details were announced via press release; the official registration page was not verified.

related.title_zh: 統合分析：失眠認知行為治療（CBT-I）可降低自殺意念，長效證據未明
related.title_en: CBT-I meta-analysis: insomnia therapy reduces suicidal ideation
related.summary_zh: Nature Mental Health 的系統性回顧統合 19 項隨機對照試驗、4,974 名參加者。CBT-I 在治療後降低自殺意念，比值比（RoM）0.77（95% CI 0.66–0.90），證據確定性高。但 1–12 個月追蹤的組間差異不顯著；自殺行為事件極罕見，無法判斷對行為的效果。
related.summary_en: A Nature Mental Health systematic review pooled 19 RCTs with 4,974 participants. CBT-I reduced suicidal ideation post-treatment (ratio of means 0.77, 95% CI 0.66-0.90) with high-certainty evidence. Effects were not significant at 1-12 month follow-up, and suicidal behaviour was too rare (two attempts in CBT-I arms across nine trials, no deaths) to judge effects on behaviour.

related.title_zh: 青少年自傷：把每次接觸服務變成照護機會——英國 544 名自殺身亡青少年資料
related.title_en: Youth self-harm and service contact before suicide
related.summary_zh: ACAMH 部落格評介英國全國連續案例系列研究（Aggarwal 等，British Journal of Psychiatry, 2025）：544 名 10–19 歲自殺身亡者中 49% 有自傷紀錄、26% 有近期自傷；近期自傷者中 60% 在死亡前三個月內曾接觸心理健康服務，95% 經歷近期逆境。另有 51% 沒有自傷紀錄。作者建議評估不只看自傷行為，也要看關係、安全與環境壓力，並提供協調的個別化照護與 48 小時內的後續追蹤。
related.summary_en: An ACAMH blog reviews a UK consecutive case series (Aggarwal et al., British Journal of Psychiatry, 2025) of 544 young people aged 10–19 who died by suicide: 49% had a self-harm history and 26% recent self-harm; among those with recent self-harm, 60% had contact with mental health services in the prior three months and 95% had recent adversity, while 51% had no recorded self-harm. The author urges broader assessment of relationships, safety and stressors, coordinated care and 48-hour follow-up.
